Contract Type: Independent contractor

Language: Applications accepted in English only

About Purolabs

Purolabs is a fast‑growing DTC supplements brand based in the UK with over 350,000 happy customers.

We create clean, science‑backed supplements that actually work. No fillers, no nasties, just real results.

Featured in Vogue, Women's Health, and Evening Standard, our UK‑made products are trusted by health‑conscious people who refuse to compromise on quality.

We're a small, family‑run team that values ownership, transparency, and getting things done without bureaucracy.

The Role

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid acquisition channels. You'll be the person in the ad accounts every day, not reviewing dashboards from a distance. This role is equal parts strategist and executor: plan the roadmap, build the campaigns, analyse the data, and optimise for profitable growth.

Your primary focus will be Meta Ads, with responsibility for expanding into TikTok, Google, and YouTube as we grow. You'll work directly with our founders and collaborate with our creative team to develop winning ad concepts and high‑converting funnels.

This isn't about vanity metrics. We care about contribution margin, not just ROAS. You'll need to think commercially and understand how paid media fits into the bigger picture of customer acquisition and lifetime value.

What You'll Own

  • Full management of Meta Ads, from campaign builds to daily optimisation and scaling
  • Testing new platforms including TikTok, Google, and YouTube
  • Creative strategy and briefing, working with designers and video editors to produce scroll‑stopping ads
  • Landing page and funnel optimisation to improve conversion rates
  • Budget allocation and forecasting across channels
  • Weekly reporting on performance, insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Building scalable processes and systems as we grow the marketing function

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years hands‑on experience managing Meta Ads for DTC / e‑commerce brands
  • Track record of profitably scaling ad spend (£30k+ monthly)
  • Strong grasp of unit economics: CAC, LTV, MER, contribution margin
  • Experience developing creative briefs and working with creative teams
  • Analytical mindset with ability to translate data into action
  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fast‑paced environment
  • Clear communicator who can explain performance and strategy to non‑marketers

Nice to Have

  • Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty
  • TikTok or Google Ads experience
  • Familiarity with Shopify, Klaviyo, Triple Whale
  • Understanding of retention and email marketing

What We Offer

  • Fully remote with flexible hours (just maintain GMT overlap)
  • Competitive rate based on experience
  • Paid time off including UK bank holidays
  • Direct access to founders with real input on strategy
  • Opportunity to shape the marketing function of a growing brand
  • Products that genuinely help people feel better

Important

  • This is a contractor position (not employment)
  • Applications welcome globally
  • Minimum 4‑hour daily overlap with UK hours required
  • Please submit CV in English
  • Note: Applications without a Vocaroo submission will be rejected.

Golang Engineer

Join to apply for the Golang Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Golang engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Go. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical prefers Golang for software where performance and security are primary considerations. We also have substantial projects in Python, C, C++ and are starting to invest in Rust. For front‑end development we prefer React and Flutter. Golang is an essential language for our engineering teams, who build the systems that deliver Ubuntu to the world. From our software distribution systems, to those which build and test every possible kind of open source on every architecture, from our systems management tools to our distributed systems operations R&D, we count on Golang for its tasteful concurrency and developer ecosystem. Juju, Livepatch, LXD, MAAS, Microk8s, Snapd, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro, and many more Canonical offerings include Golang components. We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Golang development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting‑edge open source and enterprise development. Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open‑source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully remote and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux – the more different versions of Linux the better!

Location: we have open roles for Golang engineers in every time zone.

Responsibilities

title: Instrumentation & Control Engineer - Rio
description:
Join to apply for the Instrumentation & Control Engineer - Rio role at Hanwha Ocean

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, RJ, BR

Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder to an engineering, procurement, construction, installation and operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, offshore renewables and other floating production units. The Energy Plant Unit has expanded its global footprint by establishing new Global Business Centers, aiming to become project‑centric and client‑driven, integrating upstream cultures of Asia, Europe and America.

Position Overview

As a Senior Instrumentation & Control Engineer, you will lead the design, implementation and optimization of instrumentation and control systems for major projects such as FPSO and FLNG facilities. You will provide strategic direction, mentorship and technical leadership to the engineering team, ensuring successful execution of projects in accordance with project requirements and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of instrumentation and control systems for industrial processes, including sensors, transmitters, instrument valves (PCV, On/Off valve, etc), controllers, and final control elements, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and compliance with project specifications and regulatory requirements.
  • To lead and coordinate all project Instrumentation & Control engineering issues related to equipment specification, procurement, and installation design, including but not limited to the preparation of specifications, selection of suppliers, review of vendor data, testing, development and maintenance of the instrument database, etc.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders, including process engineers, electrical engineers, and project managers, to understand project requirements, assess control strategies, and develop technical solutions. Liaison with other disciplines on packages and support the construction site team during installation and commissioning phase.
  • Develop detailed instrument specifications, data sheets, and drawings, including loop diagrams, wiring diagrams, and installation details, using CAD software and other design tools.
  • Ensure that all Instrumentation & Control designs and engineering activities comply with relevant industry standards, codes, and regulations. Review project specifications and client requirements to ensure alignment with project deliverables. Prepare formal responses to comments from classification societies and clients on specifications and drawings.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and technical evaluations to assess the performance, reliability, and safety of instrumentation systems, identifying opportunities for optimization and enhancement.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and designers, reviewing their work, providing feedback, and supporting their professional development in instrumentation engineering.
  • Oversee the installation, commissioning, and startup of instrumentation systems, ensuring adherence to project schedules, budgetary constraints, and quality standards. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development within the team. Encourage collaboration and knowledge exchange to enhance the collective expertise of the engineering team.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, including instrument index, calibration records, standard design methodologies and specifications, maintenance procedures, and safety manuals, ensuring accuracy and completeness for regulatory compliance and as-built documentation.
  • To keep abreast of relevant developments in Instrumentation engineering with respect to the offshore industry in general and the company's business in particular.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in instrumentation engineering, with a focus on design, implementation, and optimization of instrumentation and control systems for industrial processes. Experience in offshore topside design is a plus.
  • Proficiency in CAD software and other design tools used in instrumentation engineering.
  • Strong knowledge of instrumentation principles, practices, and standards (e.g., ISA, IEC), with experience in specifying instrumentation equipment and components.
  • Extensive knowledge of industry standards, industry codes and practices related to offshore engineering and Instrumentation & Control design – as well as an understanding of scientific methods of problem‑solving.
  • Strong understanding of offshore industry terminology, concepts, and practices.
  • Proficiency in Instrumentation & Control analysis and design software.
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing Topsides Instrumentation, Control and Automation Conceptual / Feasibility Studies during pre‑FEED/FEED or tender stage. Prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery (e.g. at a top‑tier FPSO contractor) will be preferred.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring abilities, with a track record of successfully leading design projects, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and achieving project objectives.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess technical challenges, identify solutions, and implement effective control strategies.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively in a dynamic engineering environment.
  • Ability to work with and to communicate effectively with co‑workers, vendors, clients.
  • Fluency in English.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world’s most deployed open source operating system, it’s a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high‑performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

The four key teams that ship Ubuntu are:

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

  • Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python

WELCOME TO SITA

Overview

At SITA , we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting‑edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. Your impact will directly influence how we introduce and scale new, customer‑driven solutions in the air transport industry. You will work at the intersection of customer insight and technical expertise, guiding our sales and product strategy by deeply understanding customer pain points, translating those into compelling solution proposals, and delivering a seamless experience from opportunity to deal closure.   • Partner with Sales and Business Development to define tailored account strategies and drive market penetration.
  • Support and influence pricing strategy and commercial modelling based on value‑driven outcomes for customers.
  • Participate in live trials, customer pilots, and PoC engagements to demonstrate measurable impact of solutions.
  • Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the global Solution Specialist Team, enabling best practices and regional insight exchange.

Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of airport/airline baggage technologies, including BIMs, BRS, MDS, and loading systems.
  • Technically fluent, with a solid grasp of cloud‑based solutions, APIs, and integration frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply customer journey mapping and insights to design solutions that solve pain points and exceed customer expectations.
  • Proven experience in customer‑centric presales processes, enabling solution design that drives customer satisfaction and commercial win rates.
  • Strong design thinking mindset, consistently approaching complex problems through iterative, user‑first solutioning.
  • Comfortable navigating high‑stakes, high‑urgency customer interactions and translating feedback into tangible solution improvements.
  • Ability to collaborate across geographies and functions to co‑create value with teams including Product Management, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Effective communicator with a talent for translating technical features into business value, able to engage at all stakeholder levels including C‑suite.
  • Commercially astute and analytically sound, capable of developing tailored pricing and go‑to‑market strategies.
  • Proficient in tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI, Visio, and Word for solution modelling and storytelling.

Nice‑to‑Have

  • Experience in introducing and scaling innovative solutions within the air transport industry.
  • Exposure to global aviation technology procurement and implementation cycles.
  • Familiarity with various pricing models and value‑based selling approaches.
  • Experienced professional in Information Technology, Airline/Airport passenger ground handling, or the broader Air Transport Industry technology domain.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Field Service Engineer

Harmonic is the worldwide leader in virtualized broadband solutions, shaping the next generation of multigigabit connectivity.

Role Description

The Field Service Engineer provides on-site installation, testing, troubleshooting, and customer support for Harmonic’s cOS virtual CMTS. This is a full-time contract position for 6–12 months.

Location

Central / South America – Hybrid role with 25–75% travel.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Install, test, and troubleshoot DAA systems, IP networks, and headend infrastructure.
  • Build and audit headend subsystems, including installing/terminating coax, Cat5/Cat6, and fiber.
  • Configure and verify headend equipment; perform system checks and diagnostics.
  • Use RF and DOCSIS meters to test and certify installations.
  • Complete documentation, test reports, and update network records.
  • Train customers on system operation and maintenance.
  • Act as an on-site liaison, identifying when issues should be routed to Sales, Support, or Engineering.
  • Follow safety procedures; lift up to 40 lbs.; work on ladders and variable schedules (including nights).

What You Should Have

  • At least 3 years of related field technician/engineering experience and an Associate’s Degree.
  • Mechanical aptitude for equipment installation and cabling work.
  • Experience in Linux at an administrative level.
  • Network troubleshooting – CCNA/CCNP, and container knowledge.
  • Basic knowledge of DOCSIS, fiber installation, and server/switch configuration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and customer-facing communication.
  • Ability to lift 30–40 lbs and work on a ladder.
  • Willingness to learn.
  • Fluent Spanish speaker (required).

Travel (if Applicable)

Central / South America hybrid role – you will be required to travel approximately 25–75%.

Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion at Harmonic Inc

At Harmonic, we believe that building and nurturing a global team with diverse backgrounds and voices is critical to our success.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award‑winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

ABOUT THE ROLE

Join our ambitious team as a Senior Software Engineer specializing in Data Engineering to develop cutting‑edge trade surveillance technology, protecting investors and ensuring market integrity. You will have a profound impact by designing and scaling robust, highly available data pipelines and microservices, tackling complex data challenges using modern tools. This opportunity offers significant influence and professional growth in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values accountability and a self‑starter attitude.

  • Experience with monitoring systems (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog).
  • Experience in object‑oriented development. Should have strong software engineering foundations.
  • Curiosity, ability to work independently and proactively identify solutions.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a remote environment.
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working in low‑latency, real‑time systems processing billions of events a day.

title: Senior Financial Analyst (FP&A)
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Financial Analyst (FP&A) role at Ottomatik.io .

2 days ago – Be among the first 25 applicants.

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst !

Note to Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst with strong FP&A experience and robust GAAP knowledge. This role requires someone who can work comfortably with complex financial models, support month‑end close activities, and drive high‑quality financial analysis for decision‑making. The ideal candidate is an Excel super‑user, experienced in building, managing, and reviewing large, integrated 3‑statement financial models. This person must also be able to lean into GAAP‑driven month‑end close review, assisting with accuracy, consistency, and quality checks across financial statements. This position is ideal for someone who has deep hands‑on FP&A experience and is comfortable working in fast‑paced environments where accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail are critical.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modeling & Analysis

  • Maintain, update, and improve large, complex 3‑statement Excel financial models, ensuring accuracy across income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.
  • Conduct regular analysis using these models to support forecasting, variance reviews, and strategic decision‑making.
  • Ensure all links, formulas, and assumptions in the model are correct, transparent, and fully auditable.
  • Serve as the primary owner of the model, performing ongoing quality reviews and consistency checks.
  • Support scenario analysis and sensitivity testing using the 3‑statement model.

GAAP Support & Month‑End Close Review

  • Assist with month‑end close review by applying strong GAAP knowledge to identify potential issues, inconsistencies, or inaccuracies.
  • Perform quality checks across financial statements to ensure GAAP compliance.
  • Collaborate with accounting partners to validate month‑end results and ensure the integrity of reporting.
  • Review month‑end reports and identify accounting adjustments that may be needed.
  • Support the team by ensuring month‑end timelines are met and that deliverables are accurate.

Excel Expertise

  • Act as an Excel super‑user, providing advanced modeling skills including formulas, functions, pivot tables, lookups, and error‑checking.
  • Ensure Excel files and financial models remain organized, consistent, and optimized for performance.
  • Create and maintain documentation of model structure, key assumptions, and calculation methodology.

General FP&A Responsibilities

  • Support core FP&A routines such as monthly reporting, forecasting, and budgeting, using the 3‑statement model as a foundation.
  • Assist with variance analysis by comparing actuals to forecast and identifying key drivers.
  • Provide clear and structured financial information to leadership.
  • Ensure financial analysis and reporting are delivered with precision and attention to detail.
  • Help maintain consistency in financial processes and standards within the FP&A function.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in FP&A or related financial analysis roles.
  • Strong GAAP knowledge and ability to apply it in practical review settings.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including expertise in managing large, integrated models.
  • Prior experience building and maintaining 3‑statement financial models.
  • Strong analytical mindset and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining high accuracy and meeting deadlines.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior/Lead C# Backend Engineer at AgileEngine, you will lead the modernization of our core systems by designing and developing highly concurrent, thread-safe applications.   • Utilize Apache Spark for distributed data processing at scale;
  • Deploy and manage solutions on AWS , ensuring reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency;

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, align architecture with business goals, and deliver high-quality solutions.

  • 5+ years of expert-level proficiency in C# with hands-on experience in multi-threaded and parallel processing;
  • Strong understanding of threading models, synchronization primitives, and concurrency debugging ;
  • Proven experience in performance tuning and application profiling for large-scale systems;
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query design, optimization, and data operations);
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark for distributed data processing;
  • Proven experience deploying solutions on AWS ;
  • Exceptional problem-solving and debugging skills with a strong focus on scalability and reliability;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience in re-engineering legacy systems into modern architectures;
  • Familiarity with microservices design principles and cloud-native development patterns;
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with a track record of working in cross-functional teams.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Software Engineer - Python and K8s
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new, open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

The role entails

  • Work in Python to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work across the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Learn to think rigorously about application and infrastructure reliability
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Simplify open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Work from home with global travel once or twice a year for up to 2 weeks for events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one public cloud
  • You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes
  • You are an experienced Python programmer and enjoy challenging projects
  • You understand the importance of reliable software and strive to design and code to that expectation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Join to apply for the Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction role at Maersk Supply Service

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect M/F

General information

OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect M/F

As an Independent Power Producer,Voltalia operates in over 20 countries, developing, building, and maintainingrenewable energy projects and services across five key technologies: solar,wind, hydro, biomass, and storage. Backed by the AFM Group, a globallyrecognized, family-owned investment group, we benefit from long-term stabilityand a shared commitment to sustainable growth.

By the end of 2024, our operational and under-construction capacity reached 3.3 gigawatts—a 14% increase since 2023. With 1,500 employees worldwide, we thrive in a fast-moving environment driven by adaptability, innovation, and collaboration.

In our company, your work directly contributes to a more sustainable world. Whether you're driving projects forward, optimizing operations, or leading strategic initiatives, you're contributing to our mission to improve the global environment and foster local development.

At Voltalia, we welcome individuals from all backgrounds, whatever your race, ethnicity, gender, nationality, age, disability, sexual orientation, and experience. In our company, diversity drives innovation and contributes to a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Ready to make an impact? Bring your energy—let’s power a sustainable future together!

YOUR MISSIONS

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availiability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic Vision-
  • Problem-Solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

A P&G é a maior empresa de bens de consumo embalados do mundo. Temos operações em mais de 75 países, com 65 marcas confiáveis que melhoram a vida de 5 bilhões de consumidores em todo o mundo. Trabalhar conosco é a melhor oportunidade para fazer o que você ama, com desafios constantes e ser reconhecido pelos seus resultados. Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro/credenciamento profissional.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em operações de logística, armazenagem e transportes.

    • NRs aplicáveis (NR-01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 10, 11, 12, 17, 20, 23, 26, 33, 35).
    • PGR, inventário de riscos, APR, permissões de trabalho, investigação de acidentes.

    • Combate a incêndio e brigada; plano de emergência e simulados.

  • Ferramentas:
    • Pacote Office/Google e ferramentas de checklists/auditorias digitais.
    • Sistemas de gestão de SST/SESMT e eSocial.
  • Habilitações/cursos desejáveis:
    • Instrutor NR-35/NR-33, brigada de incêndio, direção defensiva.
    • Noções de ISO 45001 e ISO 14001; primeiros socorros.
    • CNH B; disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Foco em segurança e cuidado ativo; presença em campo.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos diversos.
  • Influência e negociação para gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Organização, senso de urgência e disciplina na gestão de planos de ação.
  • Colaboração e postura consultiva com atendimento personalizado, alinhada aos valores DeLuna.
  • Integridade, confidencialidade e respeito às pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em operações e-commerce/last mile.
  • Experiência com gestão de transportadores terceiros e auditorias de clientes.
  • Participação em projetos de certificação e programs de cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e Atividades

1) Governança SST e Compliance

  • Atuar como integrante do SESMT conforme dimensionamento da NR-04.
  • Implementar e manter o PGR com inventário de riscos e plano de ação; apoiar as avaliações de exposição conforme NRs vigentes.
  • Apoiar a CIPA no dimensionamento, capacitação e cronograma anual; organizar SIPAT.
  • Gerir EPI/ EPC: especificação, distribuição, rastreabilidade, controle de vida útil e treinamentos.
  • Assegurarconformidade com NRs aplicáveis às operações DeLuna.
  • Acompanhar legislação aplicável ao transporte e logística e requisitos de clientes.

  • Conduzir análises ergonômicas pontuais e propor melhorias.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de combate a incêndio e suportar brigada de incêndio;
  • Verificar condições de câmaras frias e EPIs térmicos em operações frigorificadas.

3) Transporte Rodoviário (FM/MM/LM, LH)

  • Apoiar programas de direção defensiva, análise de rotas críticas, gestão de fadiga e pausas.
  • Realizar inspeções de frota focadas em segurança.
  • Verificar documentação e treinamentos obrigatórios de motoristas e ajudantes conforme a legislação aplicável.
  • Conduzir DDS e blitz de segurança em pátios e pontos de apoio.
  • Investigar sinistros rodoviários e quase-acidentes, propondo ações corretivas e lições aprendidas.

4) Saúde Ocupacional e eSocial

  • Apoiar os eventos do eSocial em conjunto com RH/DP e colaboradores.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de laudos e avaliações por profissionais legalmente habilitados, providenciando dados e acompanhando planos de ação.

5) Treinamentos, Cultura e Comunicação

  • Planejar, ministrar e/ou coordenar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos.
  • Gerenciar a matriz de capacitação, controles de validade e reciclagens; garantir 100% de aderência.
  • Conduzir campanhas e comunicações de segurança, reforçando os valores e a cultura DeLuna.

6) Emergências e Preparação/Resposta

  • Realizar simulados periódicos com brigada e times operacionais; alinhar com corpo de bombeiros e contratadas.
  • Garantir kits de emergência, fichas de segurança e contatos úteis disponíveis e atualizados.

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

  • Streaming & workflows: Kafka plus Argo/Temporal/Airflow or equivalents

Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer II
description:
15 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

The Company You’ll Join
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.
Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.
Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.
The Problems You'll Solve
At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.
As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.
You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.
You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.
The Team You'll Work With
The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.
About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn
Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

Será responsável pela análise estruturada de dados e informações, consolidada de levantamentos, além de apoiar e eventualmente orientar a realização das atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções e implementação de melhorias na gestão da rotina e dos processos da Gerência Executiva.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities, movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un‑/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE‑ and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health‑and‑safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post‑tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑level, project‑based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Seniority level

  • Mid‑Senior level

  • Contract

Job function

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Engineer - L3 Support to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Senior Associate – Global Mobility Tax
description:
Join Vialto Partners as a Senior Associate – Global Mobility Tax . Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are a market leader in global mobility services, helping companies streamline and manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner.

Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work. Working at Vialto Partners is about being part of a global and dynamic team with over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries.

We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Job Description

As a Senior Associate, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive tax and consulting experience, helping clients meet their individual income tax compliance obligations. You will address complex tax issues from strategy to execution, ensuring a smooth and efficient process.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting clients in their individual income tax compliance obligations, including preparation of individual income tax computations and returns, and handling correspondence with the respective tax authorities.
  • Resolving issues that prevent effective team working, even during times of change and uncertainty.
  • Coaching others and encouraging them to take ownership of their development.
  • Analyzing complex ideas or proposals and building a range of meaningful recommendations.
  • Addressing sub-standard work or work that does not meet company/client expectations.
  • Developing a perspective on key global trends, including globalization, and how they impact the company and our clients.
  • Managing a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
  • Focusing on building trusted relationships.
  • Upholding the company's code of ethics and business conduct.

Qualifications

Requirements include:

  • Interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
  • Demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard.
  • Experience in expatriate tax.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience for senior position.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple assignments, clients, and staff.
  • Strong analytical, organization, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Education/Graduation: Business, Law, Economy, International Relations.
  • Demonstrated business development skills and enthusiasm about contributing to the growth of the Global Mobility Services practice.

We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.
